title: New City Auditor Search Begins
summary:
*   **New City Auditor Search Initiated:** The meeting focused on launching the process to appoint a new City Auditor for the city.
*   **Nominating Committee Formed:** An ad hoc committee was established to lead the search, chaired by Mayor Kirk Watson and including Mayor Pro Tem Jackie Goodman and Council Member Daryl Slusher.
*   **Selection Timeline Set:** A clear timeline was laid out, with the full Council set to vote on the nominating committee appointments on October 5th, and candidate interviews anticipated by October 24th.
transcript:
Council Audit and Finance Committee
SPECIAL CALLED MEETING
Summary of Minutes
Thursday, September 28,2000
Council Members Attending: 
Mayor Kirk Watson, Mayor Pro Tern Jackie Goodman,
Council Members Daryl Slusher and Beverly Griffith.
Agenda Item #1: 
Nominate three members of the City Council to sit on the ad hoc
nominating committee that is responsible for appointing a new City
Auditor.
The motion to nominated Mayor Kirk Watson as the Chair, and Mayor Fro Tern Jackie
Goodman and Council Member Daryl Slusher was unanimously approved on Council
Member Griffith's motion, Mayor Fro Tern Goodman's second.
Agenda Item #2: 
Discuss ad hoc nominating committee's selection process timeline.
Ruth Ann Edwards made the presentation. At the City Council Meeting of October 5th,
Council will vote on the appointments for the Nominating Committee, then there will be a
meeting for the Nominating Commitee to distribute materials about the applicants. The
Nominatig Committee will determine which candidates will beinterviewed at the October
24tb Audit and Finance Committee meeting.
The motion to adjourn the meeting at 5:42 p.m. was unanimously approved on Council
Member Slusher's motion, Council Member Griffith's second.
